title: How Spring Came in New England
sourceTitle: How Spring Came in New England
author: Charles Dudley Warner
description: "How Spring Came in New England" by Charles Dudley Warner is a reflective and humorous essay that delves into the unpredictable nature of spring in New England, written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: This work blends elements of observational writing and natural philosophy as it explores the transitions between winter and spring in this region, vividly capturing the climatological complexities and the emotional responses they evoke in the local populace.
